prompt_stage_contract.image: Use only immutable original owner source character and location plate references; compose one first frame; avoid new identity traits and fake camera reverse
prompt_stage_contract.video: One approved first frame; three purposeful physical beats; motion-focused language; do not re-describe faces or rooms; no fake speech or unverified voice clone

hard_blockers: room geometry conflicts or missing reverse plates
first-frame missing or no human identity approval
real MP4 CGI QC not independently reviewed
known_risks: exact cropped source pixels do not certify novel expression or angle
single room source view does not certify reverse or nighttime
phrase 'no live-action' alone is not a technical style lock
prompt checks cannot diagnose generated image pixels
audio voice names do not lock waveform identity
full episode 45min target does not prove final lip sync
